name: BunniHubLogic withdrawal rounding reserve depletion
summary: BunniHubLogic.withdraw() used imprecise rounding while updating the pool's active balances. Forty-four small withdrawals burned negligible shares but substantially reduced the accounted stablecoin reserves, allowing subsequent swaps and withdrawals to extract more USDC and USDT than the burned shares entitled the attacker to.
notes: BunniHub's deployed runtime embeds BunniHubLogic 0x000000000dbb048f2e744e4b15b5aeef65e09528 as a link-time constant. The hub runtime contains that address three times and is byte-for-byte identical at deployment and immediately before the incident; the linked 24,547-byte logic runtime is also identical at both boundaries.

Bunni's official post-mortem reports approximately $8.4 million lost from the Ethereum USDC/USDT pool and Unichain weETH/ETH pool through the same withdrawal-rounding defect. The structured stablecoin components reproduce $2.37 million of exact Ethereum proceeds and provide an onchain cross-check.
